title: feat(nm2frm2lps): L-path cyclic-frame transport -e3 then +e1 at t+1 on two-axis same-lock seed: reverse HOLD, face fails
science: Bare L-path (-e3,+e1) on the two-axis same-lock seed. With #7670 it shows the same-lock seed also fails to separate the two e1 turns, so the +e1/-e1 split is specific to the near-face third pair.
